[EN] Dust Beneath My Wings
[ES] Polvo bajo mis alas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] It could be worse. Oshar could want their...interior parts.
[ES] Podría ser peor. Oshar podría querer sus... partes interiores.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Someday you'll thank me.
[ES] Algún día me lo agradecerás.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Wing Dust
[ES] Polvo de ala
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill {@linkcreature:30#150#fiery tentacullars} on the {@Rgn:30013$$Archive Grounds} and collect wing dust.
[ES] Mata {@linkcreature:30#150#fiery tentacullars} en los {@Rgn:30013$$Archive Grounds} y recoge polvo de ala.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the wing dust to {@linkcreature:230#1028$$Lihish}.
[ES] Entrégale el polvo de ala a {@linkcreature:230#1028$$Lihish}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation."
[ES] "Por la federación."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
